vocabulary.meaning_en: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere
vocabulary.example: Let's take a taxi, it's faster.

vocabulary.meaning_en: another word for a taxi
vocabulary.example: I called a cab to the airport.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person whose job is driving a taxi
vocabulary.example: The taxi driver knew a shorter way.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the money you pay for a journey
vocabulary.note_ar: تُنطق مثل fair (عادل) لكن المعنى مختلف
vocabulary.example: The taxi fare was twenty dollars.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine in a taxi that shows how much to pay
vocabulary.example: Please turn on the meter.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a short journey in a car or on a bike
vocabulary.example: Can you give me a ride to work?

vocabulary.meaning_en: extra money you give to say thank you for a service
vocabulary.example: I gave the driver a small tip.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person travelling in a vehicle who is not driving
vocabulary.example: The bus can carry fifty passengers.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an underground train system in a city
vocabulary.example: The metro is the fastest way to get around Cairo.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the American word for an underground train system
vocabulary.example: We took the subway to Times Square.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the British word for an underground train system
vocabulary.note_ar: مترو لندن يُسمى أيضاً the Tube
vocabulary.example: The London Underground is very old.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a building where trains stop for passengers
vocabulary.example: Meet me at the main station.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the raised area where you wait for and get on a train
vocabulary.note_ar: تعني أيضاً منصة مثل منصات التواصل
vocabulary.example: The train to the airport leaves from platform two.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a route that a train follows
vocabulary.example: Change to the red line at the next station.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that sells tickets
vocabulary.example: I can't find the ticket machine.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a gate that turns and lets one person through at a time
vocabulary.example: Put your ticket in the turnstile to go through.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an electric vehicle that runs on rails in the street
vocabulary.example: We took the tram to the old town.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a bicycle
vocabulary.example: Many people go to work by bike.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small vehicle you stand on, for short distances
vocabulary.example: She rents an electric scooter to get to class.

vocabulary.meaning_en: when two or more people travel in one car to save money
vocabulary.example: We use a car share to get to the office.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small bus that goes back and forth on a fixed route
vocabulary.example: The hotel has a free shuttle to the airport.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small bus
vocabulary.example: A minibus took us to the beach.

vocabulary.meaning_en: full of people
vocabulary.example: The metro is crowded in the morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: moving quickly
vocabulary.example: A taxi is fast but expensive.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not moving quickly
vocabulary.example: The bus is cheap but slow.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not costing much money
vocabulary.example: The metro is the cheapest way to travel.

vocabulary.meaning_en: costing a lot of money
vocabulary.example: Taxis are expensive at night.

vocabulary.meaning_en: easy to use and suitable for your plans
vocabulary.example: The station is very convenient for my office.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not able to get out of a place
vocabulary.example: I was trapped in the lift for an hour.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in a quiet, relaxed way
vocabulary.example: James answered calmly.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to breathe out loudly because you are tired or sad
vocabulary.example: Ali sighed and said, "Next time, I'll take a taxi."

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place on a street where a bus stops
vocabulary.example: Get off at the next stop.

fine_lines.title: metro vs subway vs underground
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الثلاثة تعني قطار المدينة تحت الأرض. metro كلمة عامة تُستخدم في كثير من الدول. subway الكلمة الأمريكية (مثل مترو نيويورك). underground الكلمة البريطانية (مترو لندن)، ويسميه الإنجليز بالعامية the Tube لأن أنفاقه تشبه الأنبوب.

examples.sentence: Paris has a very good metro system.
In New York, I always take the subway.
We took the underground to Oxford Street.

fine_lines.title: station vs stop
fine_lines.explanation_ar: station مبنى كبير فيه خدمات مثل ماكينات التذاكر ودورات المياه وكراسي الانتظار (محطة قطار أو مترو). stop مكان توقف صغير في الشارع، غالباً مجرد لافتة أو مظلة يقف عندها الأتوبيس، بدون مبنى.

examples.sentence: The train station has a café and a waiting room.
I waited at the bus stop in the rain.

fine_lines.title: fare vs fair
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الكلمتان تُنطقان بنفس الطريقة. fare اسم بمعنى الأجرة التي تدفعها للمواصلات. fair صفة بمعنى عادل، وكاسم تعني معرضاً أو مهرجاناً.

examples.sentence: The bus fare went up this year.
It isn't fair that I always pay.

expressions.example: The loud noise from the street drives me up the wall.

expressions.phrase: take a taxi / take the metro
expressions.example: We took the metro to save money.
Let's grab a taxi, we're late.
Change to the green line at the next platform.
Can you give me a ride home?

grammar.title: Present continuous with always for annoying habits
grammar.explanation_ar: عادةً نستخدم المضارع البسيط للعادات. لكن إذا كانت العادة مزعجة وتتكرر بشكل مستفز، يستخدم المتحدث الأصلي المضارع المستمر مع always أو constantly. هذا يُظهر للمستمع أنك متضايق من التكرار.
examples: He is always taking taxis and spending too much money.
The train is constantly arriving late!
She is always losing her metro ticket.

questions.question: The money you pay for a bus or taxi journey is the:
questions.explanation_ar: fare = الأجرة، أما fair فتعني عادل.

questions.question: In New York, the underground train is usually called the:
In London, people often call the underground:
questions.explanation_ar: مترو لندن يُسمى the Underground أو the Tube.

questions.question: I waited at the bus ___ for twenty minutes.
questions.explanation_ar: موقف الأتوبيس الصغير في الشارع = bus stop.

questions.question: Which sentence shows the speaker is annoyed by a habit?
choices: He takes the bus every day.
He is always taking expensive taxis!
questions.explanation_ar: المضارع المستمر مع always يعبّر عن عادة مزعجة.

questions.question: The gate that lets one person through at a time in the metro is the:
"My brother's singing drives me up the wall" means:
questions.explanation_ar: drive someone up the wall = يُجنّنه ويغضبه.

questions.question: Extra money you give the driver to say thank you is a:
A small bus that goes back and forth between the airport and a hotel is a:
questions.explanation_ar: shuttle = حافلة ترددية على مسار ثابت.
